holdout.unit: stateGroup; all candidate races/contracts for a state kept together

assumptions.entry: first fresh next target book strictly after decision plus configured latency; buy one share at displayed ask
assumptions.exit: first fresh target book strictly after entry plus horizon; sell one share at displayed bid

limitations: Hypothetical one-share quote replay, not observed fills or contest P&L.
Only source and receipt clocks represented in the capture are used; no latency extrapolation beyond the named scenarios.
Decision samples are spaced to limit within-market label overlap; markets in a state remain correlated. Group averages are descriptive, not independent significance tests.
Price co-movement and a positive simulated quote return do not establish that a live order could have filled at the displayed depth.
No fees are charged under the current challenge assumption; this does not verify future fee schedules.
